div.div:
Prefixes exchanged over the interconnect
▶ Azure advertises 10.100.0.0/24 (hub) and 10.100.1.0/24 (spoke). The spoke prefix only appears when the peering sets use_remote_gateways.
◀ AWS advertises 10.200.0.0/16. Seen on the gateway as Origin EBgp, asPath 12076-64512, across 4 ECMP next hops 10.100.0.4 - 10.100.0.7.
Both directions must be true independently. One missing direction fails ping one way only, which looks exactly like a firewall problem.
